blocks.text: You can manage agent update groups using the various options under the Actions column in the agents table.
To enable or disable the updates for a specific agent update group:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Update Groups.

Locate the agent update group for which you want to enable or disable updates, and click the X icon or the checkmark icon under the Actions column to disable or enable phased updates respectively for an agent update group.
See image.
You can see the status of each group and how many endpoints have been updated in the table.

blocks.heading: Downloading Status Details of Agent Update Groups

blocks.text: You can download the update status details of an agent update group as a CSV file.
To download update status details of an agent update group:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Update Groups.
Locate the agent update group for which you want to download the update details, and click the Download icon under the Actions column.
See image.
A CSV file with the agent group update status is downloaded to your system.
See image.

blocks.text: To edit an agent update group:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Update Groups.
Locate the agent update group that you want to edit, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
See image.
In the Agent Update Group Details window, make the necessary changes.
See image.
Click Save.

blocks.text: You can export the list of hostnames associated with an agent update group as a TXT file.
To export hostnames from an agent update group:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Update Groups.
Locate the agent update group that you want to export, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
See image.
In the Agent Update Group Details window, click Export hostnames.
See image.
A TXT file containing the list of hostnames is downloaded to your system.

blocks.text: To delete an agent update group:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Update Groups.
Locate the agent update group that you want to delete, and click the Delete icon under the Actions column.
See image.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
The agent update group is deleted.
